profile.name: Sakshi Gupta
profile.intro: I create intuitive digital experiences that combine user needs, thoughtful design, and seamless interactions.

about.text: With a passion for design and emerging technology, I explore new ways to bring ideas to life. By combining UX thinking, visual storytelling, and AI-powered workflows, I create digital experiences that are thoughtful, adaptable, and ready for what’s next.

projects.label: PROJECT 1
projects.title: Vintavia · AI-Powered Travel
projects.description: An AI-powered travel planning experience that transforms travel ideas into personalized itineraries. Users can generate trip plans based on their preferences, explore destinations, and organize their travel experiences through one intuitive platform.

projects.label: PROJECT 2
projects.title: HirePay · Recruitment Platform
projects.description: A recruitment platform designed to simplify the hiring journey for both job seekers and recruiters. With dedicated user experiences, HirePay makes it easier to discover opportunities, manage applications, and streamline the recruitment process through intuitive digital interfaces.

projects.label: PROJECT 3
projects.title: TEM · Experiential Platform
projects.description: A digital platform designed to help visitors discover immersive experiences, explore sensory activations, and book their visits effortlessly. The platform combines an engaging website with an intuitive management system to support bookings, content, and operational workflows.

projects.label: PROJECT 4
projects.title: AU Bank · Mobile Banking App Redesign
projects.description: A conceptual redesign of the AU Small Finance Bank mobile application, focused on simplifying everyday banking experiences through intuitive navigation, improved information hierarchy, and a cleaner interface. The redesigned experience makes banking tasks more accessible, seamless, and user-friendly.
